timestamp_correction.issue: Several manually entered recorded_at or frozen_at labels from the snapshot-binding stage onward were projected ahead of actual UTC while the workflow was still running.
timestamp_correction.interpretation: Those manual time labels are not chronological evidence. File-hash dependencies, successful binding validation, command exit ordering, and the generated audit created_at/run_id remain the authoritative causal sequence.

attempt_counter_correction.issue: Five infrastructure failure records used research_attempt_count_increment=0 even though the repository's cumulative attempt convention counts every separately recorded infrastructure or implementation attempt as one campaign attempt.
attempt_counter_correction.authoritative_rule_for_terminal_ledger: Count each of the five Campaign096 infrastructure or implementation failures as one attempt and the completed factor evaluation as one attempt; all have development_trial_count_increment=0.
